source_locations.excerpt: Only applicable if both the Masking parameter and the SecAllowForcingMasks parameter are set to one.

observations.expected: lockup override remains 0 when force-mask support is disabled

root_cause: The feature gate is not included in the lockup-override assignment. The code treats force_masks_i as unused when SecAllowForcingMasks is 0, but the same signal is still wired to bivium_allow_lockup and then to the primitive allow_lockup_i port.
trigger_condition: Instantiate aes_prng_masking with SecAllowForcingMasks=0 and drive force_masks_i high.
security_impact: A security-sensitive masking PRNG override can be asserted contrary to the compile-time policy that disables forced masks. This weakens the enforcement boundary for a side-channel evaluation feature that should not be active in this configuration.
limitations: The witness proves the incorrect control-path assertion at the PRNG primitive input. It does not claim that this specific run forces a persistent all-zero output stream.
